title: Tabbar margins are inconsistent and do not fill to content
line: With Plasma styles whose active-tab highlight is a full frame, the highlight around an open panel widget now surrounds its icon or text instead of being drawn over it.
explanation: The 'expanded' indicator of panel applets (CompactApplet.qml) and Show Desktop's active indicator were stretched across the panel's thickness but along the panel were exactly as wide as the applet. Breeze only draws a thin line there, so it never showed, but styles whose widgets/tabbar active tab is a full frame (like Sumac Night Molten Glass) drew their side borders over the Kickoff icon, the clock text and the Show Desktop icon. Show Desktop's frame was also stacked above its icon. The frame now grows along the panel by its own margins, so its borders sit around the applet, and Show Desktop's frame is drawn behind the icon.

commits.message:
applets: draw the expanded frame around the applet, not over it

Along the panel the expanded indicator was as wide as the applet, so
styles whose active tab is a full frame drew its borders over icons and
text. It now grows by the frame's margins, in Show Desktop's one too.

BUG: 511837

patches.diff:
From 5bb5e1467cda383b68d3918113bf45897e227392 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:39:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets: draw the expanded frame around the applet, not over
 it

Along the panel the expanded indicator was as wide as the applet, so
styles whose active tab is a full frame drew its borders over icons and
text. It now grows by the frame's margins, in Show Desktop's one too.

BUG: 511837
---
 applets/showdesktop/main.qml                     | 12 ++++++++----
 desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml | 10 ++++++----
 2 files changed, 14 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
index fbacb55b1d..ea2bccf6b5 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
@@ -115,7 +115,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         // Active/not active indicator
         KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+            id: activeIndicator
             Accessible.name: i18nc("@label Accessible name", "Minimize All Applet Active Indicator")
+            z: -1
             property var containerMargins: {
                 let item = this;
                 while (item.parent) {
@@ -132,10 +134,12 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 property bool returnAllMargins: true
                 // The above makes sure margin is returned even for side margins
                 // that would be otherwise turned off.
-                topMargin: !root.vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                leftMargin: root.vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                rightMargin: root.vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                bottomMargin: !root.vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins) : 0
+                // Along the panel, grow by the frame's own margins so its borders
+                // surround the icon instead of being drawn over it.
+                topMargin: containerMargins ? (root.vertical ? -activeIndicator.margins.top : -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins)) : 0
+                leftMargin: containerMargins ? (root.vertical ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : -activeIndicator.margins.left) : 0
+                rightMargin: containerMargins ? (root.vertical ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : -activeIndicator.margins.right) : 0
+                bottomMargin: containerMargins ? (root.vertical ? -activeIndicator.margins.bottom : -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins)) : 0
             }
             imagePath: "widgets/tabbar"
             visible: opacity > 0
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
index 1aba2a5cd9..8dfe46c93c 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
@@ -124,10 +124,12 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
             property bool returnAllMargins: true
             // The above makes sure margin is returned even for side margins, that
             // would be otherwise turned off.
-            bottomMargin: !vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            topMargin: !vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            leftMargin: vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            rightMargin: vertical && containerMargins ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : 0
+            // Along the panel, grow by the frame's own margins so its borders
+            // surround the applet instead of being drawn over it.
+            bottomMargin: containerMargins ? (vertical ? -expandedItem.margins.bottom : -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins)) : 0
+            topMargin: containerMargins ? (vertical ? -expandedItem.margins.top : -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins)) : 0
+            leftMargin: containerMargins ? (vertical ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : -expandedItem.margins.left) : 0
+            rightMargin: containerMargins ? (vertical ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : -expandedItem.margins.right) : 0
         }
         imagePath: "widgets/tabbar"
         visible: opacity > 0
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Test style with a 9-piece active tab (red corners, blue edges, green centre): Kickoff open, the frame is as wide as the icon and its borders cover it
Same: the frame now surrounds the Kickoff icon
Clock with date beside time, popup open: the side borders cut into the first '1' and the 'M'
Same: the whole text sits inside the frame
Show Desktop active: the frame is drawn on top of the icon and hides it
Same: the frame surrounds the icon, drawn behind it
Reporter's style Sumac Night Molten Glass: Kickoff pill squeezed onto the icon, clock pill over '1' and 'M', Show Desktop pill over the icon
Same style: all three pills enclose their content
Breeze before (Kickoff, clock, Show Desktop open)
Breeze after: the blue line is 6 px longer on each side (Breeze's active-tab margins)

review.text: The cause is right: along the panel the expanded frame is exactly as wide as the applet, so full-frame active tabs draw over the content. But the fix also changes how default Breeze looks: every expanded line gets 12 px longer and reaches past the applet (after-5), which the VDG and maintainers are unlikely to take as a side effect of a third-party theme bug. The patch also doesn't apply on origin/master.
changes: Keep Breeze's indicator the same: only grow the frame when the theme opts in (e.g. through the tabbar's hint-*-inset / a dedicated hint), or adjust Breeze's tabbar.svg in the same series so its line length stays the same. Get the VDG to agree on the visual change.
